exact_statement: Let g be negative exactly on {0,1,2} in six bits, h negative on {0,1,2,4,8,16,32,6,17,40}, J(x)=-h(x xor1), and Fplus=J(-1,+1,g,g,g,g). With S=4I-H in bits, inherited credit a>=-S(Fplus) and total debit D=S(Fplus)+a, every adaptive physical reveal/stopping policy querying at most two of the four remaining cores is payable with nonnegative conserved conditional credit, nonnegative total debits, zero residual, no new transfer flow and every signed old debit label conserved. The second core may be selected after observing answers in the first core. The exact minimum initial credit is -S(Fplus), with every root query continuation upper bound smaller by more than 379/100000 bits. All six chosen-pair envelopes also fit every saved A072 financial row/terminal account: 270 strict comparisons and 12 exact initial-source identities.
hypotheses: Uniform physical cube; disjoint original six-bit cores; fixed K=4; entropy bits.
